next_rule: A Phase I-D survivor remains a phenomenon candidate. The supervisor must deduplicate/translate and preregister any further confirmation before considering protected 2026; no PnL/sizing rescue is permitted.

policy.name: XAU_TEMPORAL_ROBUSTNESS_V1
notes: Input candidates are exactly the Phase I-C confirmation survivors; no new state, cutpoint, horizon, outcome, stop, target, sizing or PnL parameter is introduced.
The 2024-fitted Phase I-C quintile cutpoints remain frozen. Only 2025 is re-examined at finer temporal granularity; 2026 is forbidden.

A candidate passes only if at least 10 calendar months have sufficient state sample, at least 75% of valid months retain the Phase I-C effect sign, the median signed monthly effect retains the original Phase I-C minimum absolute effect, and both 2025 half-years independently retain the same sign and original minimum absolute effect.
Monthly and half-year tests compare the frozen state with its same-period complement, matching the Phase I-C estimand.
This phase is robustness/temporal stability only. A survivor is still a phenomenon candidate, not a strategy and not authorization to open 2026.
